notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the values for maximum player XP.
[*] Reworked the requirements for the Event pass rewards. Now the rewards for Events purchased are not limited to a specific Event.
[*] Reworked first-turn player rotation.
[*] Fixed the bug where attempting to draw a card on a full hand would temporarily highlight the card as playable.
[*] Fixed the bug where the zone highlight would go over the hovered card in the Prologue tutorial.
[*] Fixed the bug where Avatars would have their skill highlighted while not usable in the Tutorial.
[*] Adjusted the prompt for token states in the first mission of the Introduction tutorial.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Avatar wouldn’t be properly able to target the Core in Tutorial missions with no enemy Avatars.
[*] Fixed the bug where the player could trigger the next Tutorial prompts while the Settings Menu would be displayed on top.
[*] Fixed the rare bug where, upon playing more than 3 copies of Urelion, they wouldn’t properly display the sequence of VFX after
[*] energizing.
[*] Fixed the rare bug where pressing end time multiple times while many VFX are still queued would trigger an “attributes not upgraded” message.
[*] Reworked the card dissolve animation. This rework fixes several visual bugs related to the dissolve sequence itself.
[*] Added support for displaying multiple Skills in the Avatars screen.
[*] Fixed the bug where the purchase button visuals wouldn’t update upon reentering the Event’s showcase screen.
[*] Fixed the bug where the daily boost wouldn’t properly display once values below 8 were virtually reached.
[*] Disabled replay saving in tutorial matches. Now tutorial matches don’t get saved as the last match.
[*] Fixed the bug where the game would get stuck upon performing certain specific actions while an Event expired.
[*] Fixed the update of experience tracking on the profile widget.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Avatar would become non-interactive or crash the game upon reconnecting to the match.
[*] Fixed the rare bug where Core shields would be correctly applied but not visually displayed under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed the rare bug where upon disconnect after a successful Steam authentication player wouldn’t be allowed to get back to the game.
[*] Fixed the bug where an Avatar skin ready for being claimed would trigger an error that prevented doing so.
[*] Added guides for new users. New users will be prompted to complete or skip help sequences that may help them get familiar with the game UI.
[*] Added support for level limitations to game modes. Currently, players will be prevented from playing casual and ranked matches (if available) upon reaching player level 3.
[*] Adjusted the behavior of the Play button. Now it will redirect players under player level 3 toward the Single Player options and towards the Multiplayer options for players above the threshold.
[*] New players now start with 3 Daily quests.
[*] 
[*] Fixed the bug where the calculation of the card collection progress would never reach 100%.
[*] Fixed the bug where the count of cards in the graveyard would be inaccurate when multiple players would use the same cards within a turn.
[*] Fixed the bug where ambient music would stop after navigating in and out of the Deck selection screen.
[*] Fixed the visual bug where toggling trait selection in the menu would result in a brief animation of locked traits being selectable.
[*] Fixed the bug where the timers of daily reroll wouldn’t display properly.
[*] Fixed the bug where the battleground selection popup wouldn’t scroll properly.
[*] Reworked the foil animation for the card Sorrow.
[*] Fixed the bug where friend updates wouldn’t properly be synchronized between the Social menu and the lobby invite list.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would be possible to toggle the Settings menu while a choice dialog was shown.
[*] Fixed the bug where the player would be incorrectly informed about not having valid decks after they entered the deck selection screen having last selected an invalid deck.
[*] Implemented sorting in the shop tiles in order to separate owned items from purchasable ones.
[*] Added new icons for several Avatar skins.
[*] Fix the bug where the attribute selection screen would state “Show” when the attributes were already shown.
[*] Fixed the bug where discounted prices in chase items would display the currency icon in inconsistent locations.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would be possible to trigger fast flashing upon hovering a card with reference to another non-collectible card.
[*] Adjusted the animations for Tyberiuth Ascened King skin.
[*] 
[*] Fixed the bug where upon triggering the hand, full animation for an enemy the voice line corresponding to the player’s hand being fullwould be triggered instead.
[*] Added sorting to the social friend list. Now lists are sorted first by online/offline status and second by alphabetic order.
[*] Fixed the bug where Avatar damage text counters wouldn’t be triggered when attacked by Exalted units.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would be possible to attempt a purchase of an unobtainable Avatar skin after previewing another purchasable skin.
[*] Fixed the bug where multiple cards related to counters wouldn’t display their keywords as related concepts.
[*] Adjusted the relation between the keywords acid and caustic. Now cards with the acid keyword won’t display the caustic tooltip unless both keywords appear in the same card.
[*] Fixed the bug where the list of online friends wouldn’t be updated in real-time.
[*] Fixed the bug where the player could get the input field for finding friends filled with wide characters and end up being unable to delete them.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would be possible to attempt to navigate to the Player profile while the faction choice popup was still active.
[*] Fixed the visual bug where the level orb would hang over the Avatar name on the Profile screen.
[*] Fixed the bug where quests would not update properly.
[*] Fixed the bug where units with 0 attack power would not get vulnerability damage.
[*] Fixed the bug where Highlord’s Warcry wouldn’t display the proper animation positions.
[*] Fixed the bug where Neutral cards wouldn’t be counted as played for faction-specific quests.
[*] Resolved the issue where players would lose their purchased content if it was purchased during an ongoing matchmaking. Now purchases are only possible while the player is not actively queued for a match.
[*] Fixed model and animations of Basson’s skin Snow Hunter.
[*] Added localization support for default names of user-generated decks and replay files.
[*] Fixed the rare bug where the player could try to create new decks upon surpassing the deck limit.
[*] Fixed the bug where some buttons would have a much wider hover area than expected.
[*] Fixed the bug where scrolling the card Collection would produce inconsistencies in the animation of card quantities.
[*] Fixed the visual bug where the text of certain Avatar Skills would overflow the designated area.
[*] Fixed the bug where discounted shop prices would be off by 1 compared to the final subtracted amount.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would appear to be possible to interact with the icon of a friendly profile.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would not be possible to scroll the friend list within the social popup.
[*] Fixed the bug where manually reverting all the shortcut keys to their original bindings would still keep available the button for resetting them.
[*] Fixed the bug where attempting to reset all the bindings would close the Settings menu.
[*] Fixed the bug where the list of featured shop items could not be scrolled.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Event Shop tab wouldn’t display the tooltip over the Event timer..
[*] Fixed the bug where the enemy ambush indicator wouldn’t sometimes show on time as expected.
[*] Fixed the bug where tooltips would fail to show in the intended position while being displayed at different screen resolutions.
[*] Adjusted the default displayed values for custom Cores in the Cores screen.
[*] Enhanced the visuals for the text indications of invalid decks.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Avatar stand would display a call to action highlight over a muted skill under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed the bug where dragging an energy card before reaching a valid zone would trigger a “No Valid Targets” error message.
[*] Fixed the bug where cards with OnPlay effects would fail to be destroyed with the right dissolve effect.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would be possible to interact with background elements while the AI Redirect prompt was shown.
[*] Fixed the bug where it would be possible to visually select a different deck under certain conditions while Match Making was active.
[*] Fixed the bug where History and Player Info bars wouldn’t be properly sorted while visualizing the Card Art popup.
[*] Added support for displaying tags in special event cards.
[*] Fixed the bug where some buttons would lose their hovering highlight when clicking on them with the secondary mouse button.
[*] Fixed the bug where the game would crash upon certain conditions while attempting to reconnect to an already loaded but still not
[*] started match.
[*] Implemented a Winstreak-based rewards system.
[*] Expanded the guides for helping new players get familiar with the game.
[*] Removed the winstreak widgets from Deck Selection and Multiplayer screens. 
[*] Adjusted the visuals for winstreak widgets. 
[*] Reworked quest highlights. 
[*] Added winstreak widget in the Main menu screen. 
[*] Updated and extended several guides. 
[*] Added button soft lock while rerolling daily quests. 
[*] Fixed the bug where players who had been inactive for a long time would get an undefined winstreak value. 
[*] Fixed the bug where the weakness card could be played even while the player’s Avatar was subdued. 
[*] Fixed the bug where the “Change icon” text on the Profile screen would get stuck upon switching profiles while hovering. 
[*] Fixed the bug where navigation submenus could get stuck upon navigating to them and hovering the section again. 
[*] Fixed the bug where cards in the Mulligan screen would toggle their outline upon accepting. 
[/list]

notes.title: 0.61.5 to 0.62.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the hovered card in the Tutorial Prologue could still be hovered twice.
[*] Fixed problem where cards in the Shrine for Avatar trait info would not show their images.
[*] Fixed Tears of Harigazz not showing animation when there are no units on the battleground.
[*] Added action soft lock while waiting for the server response in order to avoid invalid Favourite Achievement requests.
[*] Implemented some better connection handling with the server.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could open settings in a Tutorial while the Tutorial is ending which could cause the game to get stuck.
[*] Fix the daily boost bug where after each match daily boost would refill itself.
[*] Removed win streak tracking vs A.I.
[*] Fixed win streak display amount.
[*] Fixed bug with disabled Avatar Skill in the Tutorial mission 4.
[*] Fixed bug with redirect damage applied to the unit with shield counters where damage would display as -1.
[*] Fixed bug with invalid quest causing the game to break.
[*] Removing effects from units displayed in action history.
[*] Fixed bug where “morph” would also copy counters.
[*] Fixed REAP trigger bug, where REAP would stop executing after 2 times (e.g. Malefice killing max 2 units).
[*] Fixed bug with player’s turns starting before the animations are finished in vs AI game. Bot end turn action is delayed in order to show animations and end turn regularly.
[*] Fixed bug where Avatar could not be rotated in the Deck Customization menu.
[*] Fixed some auto-reconnect bugs that can disable the user hover in a match if they happen while the user had a unit selected.
[*] Fixed some bugs that could have happened when there was a problem with starting a match and the client would be left in infinite looking for match state.
[*] Disabled the option of switching Camera Angles.
[*] Tooltips that appear while hovering are now better placed.
[*] Fixed the bug where trying to navigate to the profile of another player from the sent invite would lead the player to their own profile.
[*] Adjusted the default behaviour for delayed tooltips and resetting after user interaction.
[*] Fixed the bug where editing a deck wouldn’t allow to save it again unless its name was also changed.
[*] Fixed the bug where entities in limbo would lose information upon reconnecting.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash upon trying to enter the deck selection menu without a valid deck.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where upon resizing the screen in unusual ways (i.e. windows shortcuts) the new settings would fail to be properly applied.
[*] Fixed visual issues with token art layer sorting.
[*] Fixed the issues with Token Dissolve visuals.
[*] Fixed the text display error whereupon unlocking a new faction the base deck notification would show incorrect information instead of the correct content.
[*] Mitigated the bug where changing a card foiler would spread changes among default foilers, new decks and deck customizations.
[*] Fixed the bug where Social Pop-up input field placeholders wouldn’t display the correct information.
[*] Fixed the bug where the Tutorial would get stuck on Introduction - Mission 1 - Event 6.

notes.title: Announcement: Avatar Removal
notes.content:
Dear Denizens of Issilith!

As we prepare to officially launch PHAGEBORN sometime in the New Year, we have some big changes happening within the game. Most notably the removal of specific Avatars, they are not gone forever and will be available in time within the FREE TRACK of the Battle Passes that will be coming out in the future with the full release of the game. We are using this as a test for future Battle Passes which will have some new and never seen before Avatars and skins to introduce to you all. 

Removed Avatars:

- Basson
- Evie
- Yggron
- Tarro

We understand that some of you may be playing with these Avatars in your custom decks and these Avatars will be replaced with the default Avatar for your chosen Faction, players who have had these Avatars removed will get 5 Avatar souls per unlocked Avatar back.

We are aware that some players have been facing connectivity issues within the game and we have improved on this in the patch. Please reach out to us if you are still facing issues and your feedback helps us to continue squish bugs.

We encourage you to let us know any feedback you have about this in the [url=discord.gg/WKHXBWM]Discord[/url]. We have a little something planned in the New Year for you all to get involved in so keep an eye out for any more updates we have coming your way as we prepare for launch in the sometime New Year.

Maybe take this time to explore something new… New Year, New Avatar!

Yours truly,

Games Revolted

notes.title: Announcing our new Battle Pass plans
notes.content:
Dear Denizens of Issilith!

Making a game like Phageborn we know how critical it is to make sure we focus on keeping true to our community while making a game that you can be proud to play. The key to this is providing you with reasons to keep coming back and that means we need to be able to make sure we can continue to develop content for the game.

We passionately believe it's important to delve deeper into the lore, give you exciting and challenging missions, explore the history of the factions, and other cool features over time. Doing this requires constant development and  we have to make sure that we are able to give you the best experience we can, rewarding you for coming with us on this thrilling journey, and make the game better for everyone playing. At the end of the day, we want to make sure we can keep working on a game you enjoy playing, and that we love making.  

We need to find a way to support the game based on the value we deliver to you the players. That’s just not possible with a single up-front price for the game. Instead we want to find a way to unlock the game for everyone, and support the game by making exceptional content experiences that you love and that keeps you playing over and over again. 

So we are planning to drop the up-front price and instead move to a Battle Pass Model which rewards actually playing the game. But we think its vital that we make sure that everyone who has supported us so far gets treated like the champions they are! 

So here is what we are planning…


[b]***Importantly this is an ongoing discussion***[/b]

[b]We are not going to sell Card Packs![/b]

We have listened to you and understand that for many of you it's important that we don’t sell ‘booster packs’ of cards (unlike many other card games). Instead, we will continue to make sure that you can unlock cards through ‘Seal Trees’ earned from playing the game; learning them and mastering as you go. We will share more about how ‘Seal Trees’ work in future posts!!


[b]We are going to add Battle Passes [/b]

The game will have a set of missions updated each week that will allow you to unlock content as part of each Battle Pass that everyone can take part in. That means that anyone can earn items from the Battle Pass no matter what. But there will be extra missions for you if you buy the Battle Pass as well. 
A key thing here is that you can unlock what you want from the Pass when you want to, either as soon as you can or taking your time getting to the other items whilst the Pass is still active. Special items may sometimes be locked behind levels or specific quests , but if you have your eye on an especially shiny cosmetic for your favourite Avatar, it's up to you if you want to grab that first! What is in each Battle Pass will change too, but we want to make sure that it is deeply tied into the story and built on the Lore. We even plan on having some in-game events that will spice up how you play, all linked to the Battle Pass that is going at the time. 

BattlePasses will include:
[list][*] New Cards (obtainable by everyone – no pay to win)
[*] New Battlegrounds (each with unique music)
[*] New Avatar Skins
[*] New Foils
[*] New Avatar voice lines
[*] …and many more new things that we haven’t introduced yet (We don’t want to spoil everything).[/list]

[b]Everyone who has bought the game before 20th of April 2022 will get a Founders Pass[/b]

If you have bought our game up until the 20th of April 2022 you will permanently unlock the following:
[list][*] Ability to create a Guild (Anyone can join one)
[*] Access to Ranked mode queue 
[*] Uncapped deck slots (We are still designing how many slots premium players will have)
[*] Special Founder’s tag 
[*] Unique King Tyberiuth skin
[*] …other perks we are still designing[/list]

But most importantly [b]***you will get the first year’s Battle Passes included for free!!***[/b]

[b]Anyone can play for FREE[/b]

We want to make the game available for everyone. We will do so at full release of the game for anyone to play but free players will have some restrictions. These include:
[list]
[*] Not being able to create a guild (but able to join)
[*] Only access to the Casual mode Queue
[*] Capped Deck slots (Again we are still exploring the numbers)
[*] Normal quests only[/list]

But! We are also looking at offering players a one-time purchase option to unlock these restrictions, whether or not they buy a BattlePass - we would love to know what you think?

Also! We are thinking about whether we should offer people who didn’t manage to unlock some items from the previous month’s Battle Pass to be able to pay for what they missed? Certain  items would only be available from playing missions in the game. 

We want to hear what you think about this. 

Comment below or join our Discord channel ([url=https://discord.com/invite/V6p9BMHbh4]Discord[/url]) and join the ongoing discussion with your questions, thoughts, and feedback. 

Yours truly,
Games Revolted

notes.title: Patch #2 is out!
notes.content:
Residents of Issilith!

Second update has been implemented successfully!

We encourage you to stay tuned for more info and please continue to suggest your ideas and thoughts, bug reports, etc, because that helps us advance and do better!

Read all about the patch notes below.


[b]Card changes[/b]

Tikiri Ambusher can now only target enemy units, this was made to prevent players from having to deal damage to own units

Khalai Slayer can now only target enemy avatars, this was made to allow players to play that unit if enemy has no avatar without having to deal damage to own avatar

Bloodfiend - Effect now triggers ON PLAY, changed stat gain to +4|+4 (from +3|+3)

Overpower now works if you kill enemy avatar

Malefice is now local

Forbidden hex is now local

Sporecreeper now targets only enemy units

Apriosa ON PLAY is now local

Entangle is now local

Widow’s kiss now works locally


[b]Bug fixes[/b]

Fixed a bug where you were unable to see enemy ambush indicator after reconnecting to the game

Emino now doesn’t reduce its cost if it didn’t copy any legendary

Fixed a bug where effect of Urelion worked only once

Fixed a bug where last card you drawn appeared like it was playable before you got attribute selection

Fixed a bug where your units appeared ready before you got to the attribute selection

Fixed a bug where you were able to put units on the battlefield before attribute selection

Fixed a bug where damage indicator in history was displayed on your card when you attacked enemy core

Fixed a bug where “Match found” stayed in the deck selection screen in 2v2

Fixed a bug where Borgojag did not work on enemy units

Fixed a bug where wrong error was displayed when player tried to play energy card that has units as a target on empty battlefield

Fixed a bug where unit that stackable had mod stolen by Genemite could get stolen stacks back by applying that mod again

Fixed a bug where units copied by Sumac could sometimes just change stats

Fixed a bug where Rematerialize appeared like it killed a unit in action history

Fixed a bug where titles of avatars didn’t scale down if text was too long

Fixed a bug where Sleeping Giant didn’t have tooltip for altered stats

Fixed a bug where Bloodfiend didn’t have tooltip for altered stats

Fixed a bug where Focused Sharpshooter didn’t have tooltip for altered stats

Fixed a bug where Sleeping Giant gained +8 power instead of +7

Fixed a bug where “card destroyed” animation didn’t appear if a player drawn a card with full hand

Fixed a bug where healing indicator number didn’t scale if the value was over 19

Fixed a bug where referenced cards didn’t have background for health in the keywords

Fixed a bug where login screen had “Beta Participation Agreement” title

Fixed a bug where Lyxia’s trait pictures were swapped in shrine

Fixed a bug where skill descriptions didn’t scale if they had too long text

Fixed a bug where health of avatar displayed both maximum values and normal values at once

Fixed a bug with Theodora lightning

Fixed a bug with avatar skill highlight going over avatar skill cost

Fixed a bug where you could get stuck if you invited a player without valid a decks to a 2v2 match

Fixed multiple visual bugs on pvp menu

Fixed a bug where avatar health appeared as buffed at the start of the game (green number instead of white)

Fixed a typo in shrine

Fixed a bug where skill of Yggron stayed hovered after use

Fixed a bug where you were unable to see unlock button in blacksmith while using lower resolution

Fixed a bug where you could get stuck in-game if another player quit the game in the moment when you matched with it

Added missing text on Klexrav Machinist to indicate that it spawns units locally (effect didn’t change)

Fixed a bug where you sometimes couldn’t queue in 2v2

Fixed a bug where morphed unit retained factions of old cards instead of changing it to a faction of the effect that morphed it

Fixed a bug where vulnerability displayed damage too early

Fixed a bug where health restored by regenerate mod did not display in history

Fixed a bug where attack icon of avatar wasn’t closed very first turn

Fixed a bug where Ragewarden displayed damage indicator while it was invulnerable

Fixed a bug where Sprite of Respite didn’t really work locally


[b]Features
[/b]
New graphics for settings screen

Sound settings now have sound sliders to adjust the volumes

You can now look at ally hand during attribute selection in 2v2

Optimized area for display name to fit larger names

REAP now works only when you attack with the unit, not when unit is attacked

Added explanation for acid counters whenever explanation for caustic appeared

Reduced hover hitbox on the ambush indicator

You can now use social while queued for match

Added new avatar skill icons

Removed back button in deck builder screen, you can go back by clicking on library or any other menu

Deleting a deck now takes way less time than before

Changed a way how vulnerability functions: Now it deals pure damage to entity equal to the number of vulnerability counters on it instead of removing life. This means that unit with vulnerability counter on it can trigger when damaged effect twice by taking combat damage once.

Added VFX indicating that you are looking at hand of ally when you press alt

Added maintenance message to warn players when the servers will be unavailable

Added effect on unit when it has “can’t move”

Effects that spawn a unit (like infest) now have spawned unit displayed as keyword


[b]Updated library filters screen:[/b]

Added filter to display legendary cards

Added filter to toggle display locked cards

When in deck builder this filter is off by default

When in collection: this filter is on by default

Changed other filters into drop down to make space for new filters


Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/SkqYRSH]Discord channel[/url] and participate in the community!

notes.title: Patch is out!
notes.content:
Dear community! 

First Early Access patch update is out! 

We are beyond thankful for your constant suggestions, bug reports and awesome ideas because it helps us to further improve the game!

We encourage you to stay tuned for more info and please continue to suggest your ideas and thoughts, bug reports, etc because that helps us advance and do better!

Read all about  the patch implementation below.

[b]Card/avatar changes[/b]

•	Av'Xonti now has repel
•	Khalai Slayer: effect now gives this unit +1|+1 (from +2|+2)
•	Ubbu Gyrocopter: removed leadership threshold form effect
•	Lyxia - Abyssal Knowledge: reduces skill cost by 2 (from 1)
•	Urelion: new card effect - ENERGIZE: Deal damage to a random local enemy unit equal to the energy spent
•	Magathor - cost reduced to 8 (from 9)
•	Primal rage - cost reduced to 7 (from 8)
•	Orniseth - health reduced to 4 (from 6)
•	Warpling - health reduced to 2 (from 3)
•	Power blow - cost reduced to 6 (from 7)
•	Aspect of power - cost reduced to 7 (form 8)
•	Metamorph - cost reduced to 3 (from 4)
•	Khalai trapper - stats increased to 3|3 (from 2|2)
•	Blinkstrike - cost reduced to 3 (form 4)
•	Frostfang Stalker - cost reduced to 4 (from 5)
•	Deprived - stats changed to 0|1 (from 1|1)
•	Seismic shock - cost reduced to 5 (from 6)
•	Agredora - health increased to 8 (from 6)
•	Grarg Howler - power increased to 3 (from 2)
•	Instant Karma - removed minus energy effect (this also fixes some of the bugs related to this card)
•	Blight (curse obtained by Instant Karma) - cost increased to 4 (from 3)
•	Sprite of Respite - can only target friendly avatars
 
 
[b]Bug fixes[/b]

•	fixed an issue with matchmaking that made players wait for match longer than intended
•	fixed a bug where Avatar icon did not close when Avatar wasn’t able to attack
•	fixed a bug with wrong tooltip when you hovered over find match in 2v2 pvp
•	fixed a bug in deck builder where error texts were under the cards and hard to read
•	updated arts on cards and fixed ones that had wrong/missing art
•	fixed a bug where you could get stuck in match if one player surrenders while other player was reconnecting
•	fixed a bug where text info on cards went trough card tooltips and stats screen
•	fixed a bug where turn indicator and attribute selection window could show in the victory/defeat screen
•	fixed a bug where sometimes you still had call to action on energy cards while your Avatar was subdued
•	fixed most of the cases where you could load the game forever (we are still working on some rare cases where that could happen, current workaround is to restart the game)
•	fixed a bug where Combat Librarian didn’t obtain a combat note if it traded with enemy unit
•	added VFX on ability activation of 15 cards
•	fixed a bug where reap effect of Stormreaver worked only once
•	fixed a bug where Deadwoods made by the Conjuring had wrong type
•	fixed a bug in shrine where every faction was labeled as “Neutral”
•	fixed a bug where Basson’s - Overpowering Blow worked even if unit didn’t deal any juggernaut damage
•	fixed a bug where Energy Gorger and Verisllion’s Oathsworn’s ability didn’t work if you mulliganed them before
•	fixed a bug where tooltip for altered stats didn’t appear
•	fixed a bug with Lyxia - Voidlink Slash where it didn’t work if you increased its power for next attack and then attacked enemy avatar
•	fixed a bug with Lyxia - Voidlink Slash where it counted any damage dealt to enemy avatar instead of just attacks of your avatar
•	fixed a bug where morphed unit when returned to hand would return to the old card instead of staying morphed
•	fixed a bug where Seismic Shock lasted only until end of the turn instead of all the time
•	fixed a bug where Seismic Shock was wrong faction
•	fixed a bug where Sprite of respite could target subdued avatars
•	fixed a bug where 2 Maiden of Pain could create infinite loop
•	fixed a bug where timer didn’t show for other player when queued for 2v2
•	fixed a bug where armor did not display metal plate on health of an Avatar
•	added obtained/spawned card descriptions when hovering over avatar in match (next step is to add same descriptions while in other menus)
•	fixed text typos on card and avatar effects
•	fixed Ubbu Mechcrafter displaying wrong art when played
•	fixed font overlay displaying over “your turn” banner
•	fixed a problem with card text updating before actual effect was updated
•	fixed name of unit spawned on the text box of Khaina
 
[b]Favorite battleground rework[/b]

•	game now remembers your last battleground selected
•	battleground you selected is now always displayed for you locally
•	added “random” option for favorite battleground
•	default selection for favorite battleground is now random
 
[b]Other changes[/b]

•	increased speed of multiple units dying from acid damage - we are also working on the other cases where animations are too slow (including avatar animations)
•	changed card copy mechanic: copy of the card now copies buffs and debuffs too
•	improved lightning in pvp menu
•	improved hover signalization on avatar leadership flag on cards that had leadership threshold
•	added text and description on “Ambush played” card when enemy plays an ambush
•	added notification while waiting for mulligan to appear that you are waiting for other players
•	added “X” to close tutorial video
•	added confirmation for unlocking the avatar
•	changed wordings on rooted and snared descriptions to clarify that those units only can’t use attack action since they can still be forced to attack by effect
•	added on hover explanations in the Shrine
•	added selected faction display in blacksmith
•	added icon next to progress points in blacksmith screen
•	added new buttons for unlock and confirm unlock


Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/mFBBAJk]Discord channel [/url] and participate in the community! 

See you in the game,

Filip from Games Revolted

notes.content:

notes.title: Changelog for the 3rd Closed Technical Beta
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here's a list of changes that we have in this iteration of our Closed Technical Beta tests

[h1]Features:[/h1]

-Hovering over your core now displays only keywords instead of whole image of core that covered up whole screen
-Hovering over your core now shows maximum values of core life and resources all at once
-Made more obvious that you can type in your deck name
-Added infest visual effect
-Added visual effect on curse cards to differentiate them from normal cards
-Number of cards in collection now update as you add them in deck to show how many more of that card can be added
-Added hover responsiveness to all the buttons
-Found missing librarian in card collection menu
-Added a warning when you are about to cancel editing your deck without saving it
-Hovering over cards or avatars is not disabled when enemy does actions anymore
-Removed avatar size pop out when you hover over it
-Added scroller to pvp menu
-Moved back button below continue and changed color to red
-Added multiple fields to "report a bug" form with 2 required fields to encourage more detailed bug reports (giving as much details as possible helps a lot in fixing some bugs)
-Added new error explaining that player that goes first can't attack with avatar first turn
-Improved visuals of ability cards while in targeting mode
-Changed color of cancel finding match to red
-Removed resist mod from the game
-Added VFX when a unit has buff or debuff
-Added overlay that indicates who has turn
-Added new cards

[h1]Balancing:[/h1]

-Krorn battlemaster stats from 3|3 to 2|2
-Aspect of power cost from 7 to 8
-Unchained megadon power from 7 to 6
-Daughter of misery health from 3 to 2
-Berthana health from 8 to 6
-Virulent hag power from 3 to 2
-Sparkmage health from 2 to 3
-Alina cost from 4 to 6
-Placid larfa stats from 5|4 to 4|3
-Hammerhead health from 8 to 7
-Tyberiuth trait 2 removed and replaced with new one (Your special attacks cost 1 less to play.)
-Nex trait 2 changed to: +2 Health. If your voidling died since the last turn your avatar has +1 power until end of your turn.
-Versilion's Oathsworn: stats from 8|8 to 7|7, cost from 20 to 16, ability now reduces cost by 1 for each avatar attack instead of 2
-When you subdue enemy avatar, you draw 1 card instead of 1

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]

-Made GPU optimizations, load on your graphic card should decrease by around 50%
-Fixed a bug where replicate triggered on energy cards
-Fixed a bug where Sporelug did not stack caustic mod on units
-Fixed a bug where faction icons in deck building filters had strange colors
-Fixed a bug where long user names did not fit in vs screen
-Fixed a lot of cases where players weren't able to get mulligan on draw any cards at the start of match
-Fixed a bug where Agni ronin gave more than 1 attack to your avatar
-Fixed a bug where Forbidden hex did not set stats to leadership every time
-Fixed a bug where saffron skill added additional history log.
-Fixed a bug where ball of Zhuttg was clipping with some background objects
-Fixed a bug where 0 cost cards were missing in filters
-Fixed a bug where names on cards weren't centered
-Fixed a bug where you were able to change pages by clicking on the middle of deck list
-Fixed a bug where "main menu" label acted like button
-Fixed a bug where instant flash of locks were displayed when you changed back to main menu
-Fixed a bug where you could get attribute selection when inside victory screen
-Fixed a bug where avatar would be highlighted even if it is not your turn
-Fixed a bug where white line was visible in trailer
-Fixed a bug where Faceless Maiden did not change the cost correctly
-Fixed a bug where Zhuttg trait Syphon Stamina worked only once per match
-Fixed a bug where Genemite was unable to attack the same turn you played it if it stole dash mod
-Fixed a bug where players were able to change maps while waiting for match
-Fixed a bug where avatar power value and skill cost stayed on screen during attack animation
-Fixed a bug where lowest graphic settings made textures look "pixelized"
-Fixed a bug where if you click in the search bar, "search" word kept showing
-Fixed a bug where you were unable to hover cards in hand after you hide attribute selection
-Fixed a bug where you would get "Not enough energy" after clicking on the enemy avatar skill
-Fixed a bug where artwork of ability cards was square instead of circle
-Fixed a bug where avatars clipped trough traits
-Fixed a bug where resist mod reduced acid damage
-Fixed a bug where power of your avatar was displayed while in targeting mode
-Fixed a bug where some sounds still palyed when oyu turned off the sounds
-Fixed a bug where seedlings lost ready state after being morphed
-Fixed a bug where you could activate vulnerability counters by attacking with unit that has 0 power
-Fixed a bug where Deny! reduced cost instead of increasing it
-Fixed a bug where adjacent units didn't morph immediately morph when using primoridal shaping
-Fixed a bug where highlight stayed on subdued avatar

[h1]Known bugs:[/h1]

-Zhuttug "Syphon Stamina" stamina is not working at all
-Ozzordomu "Consume Ashes" works only once
-Sometimes you can get stuck on match found screen (workaround is to cancel and click on find match again)
-Sometimes mulligan doesn't appear (workaround is to surrender and start a new match)
-Loud sound on trailer on some machines
-Ultra wide screen resolution problems

[h1]Major features for upcoming betas:[/h1]

-2v2 mode
-More avatars
-Custom game (select your teammates and enemies)

Enjoy your time with the beta this weekend! :)

notes.title: Monetization model reveal
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34608757/b66d5246f0c0e3be3764f5c13ff6b79199825ea9.jpg[/img]

Phageborn will feature gameplay content - cards and avatars - that will only be unlockable by playing. This means we will be adopting a [b]premium, buy-to-play monetization model[/b].

[h1]Why are we doing this?[/h1]
We wanted to do something a bit different for our game, to make our gameplay be pure gameplay. Instead of playing to acquire random content you might or might not like, you will know what to expect and when to expect it. [b]Unlock content you want, at your own pace[/b].

[h1]Unlocking content[/h1]
You will level up your account as you play, which will award you points for unlocking cards. You can imagine these as a form of "upgrade points". You will use these points to upgrade a faction, leveling it up and gaining access to more of their cards. Neutrals will always level up, regardless of your factions, so you can have more deckbuilding options when you switch to leveling a lower level faction.
[b]Progress will be earned through gameplay[/b]. Win or lose, you will gain some, with wins giving you more progress. We don't want you to feel like you're wasting your time if you lose.

[h1]Avatar reworks[/h1]
Along with this, we have a rework to how our Avatars work. Avatars used to level up during gameplay, gaining access to perks that could change how you play the game. These perks are no more.

[h1]Avatar traits[/h1]
Instead of perks, Avatars will have [b]traits[/b]. They are similar to perks - passive bonuses that empower your Avatar in some way, or even change their playstyle. However, you can have only one trait, and that trait is selected during the deckbuilding process instead of during gameplay. While some perks were encouraging some forms of alternate deckbuilding, there could be situations where you don't even reach the perk you wanted. [b]Traits are picked during deck construction[/b], so you don't have to worry about not reaching them.

[h1]Avatar special cards[/h1]
In addition to these traits, with every Avatar having 3 traits to choose from, they will also have [b]exclusive cards[/b]. These cards can be used in your deck only with their corresponding Avatar. These also serve to replace perks, as well as to give more flavor and more uniqueness to each Avatar. You will start with one perk unlocked, with the exclusive cards and other two perks unlocked as you play with the Avatar.
----------
We strive to bring you the best gameplay experience we can offer, and for you to create your own experience the way you see fit. We hope we can achieve this through our monetization decision, and we hope you will stay with us on this journey ahead. We'll reveal the official pricing for the game somewhere down the line, most likely alongside the official release date for the game. 

For now, the only thing we can say is that it will be fair :) 

Until then, enjoy the content we'll be delivering in the meantime and don't forget to add us to your Steam wishlist!
